p: day the LORD with his severe: At the time appointed.
sword shall punish leviathan the piercing: That is, by his mighty power, and by his word. He prophecies here of the destruction of Satan and his kingdom under the name of Liviashan, Assur, and Egypt.
of red wine: Meaning, of the best wine, which this vineyard, that is, the Church would bring forth, as most agreeable to the Lord.

is not in me: Therefore he will destroy the kingdom of Satan, because he loves his Church for his own mercies sake, and cannot be angry with it, but wishes that he may pour his anger on the wicked infidels, whom he means by briers and thorns.
take hold of my strength: He marvels that Israel will not come by gentleness, unless God make them to feel his rods, and so bring them to him.
He shall cause them that descend: Though I afflict and diminish my people for a time, yet will the root spring again and bring forth in great abundance.
him: He shows that God punishes his in mercy, and his enemies in justice.
measure: That is, you will not destroy the root of your Church, though the branches of it seem to perish by the sharp wind of affliction.
fruit to take away his sin: He shows that there is no true repentance nor full reconciliation to God, till the heart is purged from all idolatry and the monuments of it are destroyed.
fortified city shall be desolate: Not withstanding his favour that he will show them later, yet Jerusalem will be destroyed, and grass for cattle will grow in it.
women come: God will not have need of mighty enemies: for the very women will do it to their great shame.
river to the stream of Egypt: He will destroy all from the Euphrates to the Nile: for some fled toward Egypt, thinking to have escaped.
blown: In the time of Cyrus, by whom they would be delivered: but this was chiefly accomplished under Christ.
